The q+1 binary labels therefore separate points on T^q times that full-measure set. Atom boundaries are finite affine pieces y=1/2, y=x_j and seams, satisfying piecewise-smoothness. The exceptional set is Haar-null; neither ergodicity of T_q nor an everywhere generator is asserted.

The common refinement has EXACTLY 2**q lower-strip cells plus ONE common upper-strip cell: 2**q+1 polygonal atoms for every q. Since 2**q+1<=2**(q+1) for every q>=1, the previously published construction gives the entire assigned theorem, with strictly sharper cell bound, by a routine finite-join pullback.
